integrity: Exact finite-dimensional characteristic-polynomial proof with standalone symbolic checker; six finite-step tests are supporting diagnostics only. Prior general moment formulas and nematic higher-harmonic sensitivity acknowledged. Same-model review only; independent priority and proof audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive four-heading circulant coins, stationary initial heading, fixed displacement length, and exact infinite-time fourth cumulant per step. No finite-sample stability, noisy-data or zero-probability-boundary theorem is claimed. Original five-operation coin parameters cannot be separately recovered.
title: Sharp fourth-cumulant tomography of the hidden nematic coin in a chiral lattice walk
